entities.summary: Tagesschau24 is a German free-to-air television channel owned by ARD and managed by Norddeutscher Rundfunk (NDR). Launched on 30 August 1997 as "EinsExtra", the channel was renamed Tagesschau 24 on 1 May 2012, becoming a brand extension of ARD's evening newscast.
